title: Holo4 (Holo4-27B-GGUF, Holo4-35B-A3B-GGUF)
description: Serve Holo4 (Holo4-27B-GGUF, Holo4-35B-A3B-GGUF) on Runpod Serverless with vLLM. Computer use agents are a fast growing self-host workload, and teams want them on their own GPUs for privacy and cost control over long screenshot-heavy loops. Two sizes cover different rentals: the 27B dense fits a single 48GB to 80GB card, while the 35B-A3B MoE runs cheap per token and scales well for parallel agent sessions. GGUF weights mean day-one llama.cpp and Ollama deploys with the hai-agents harness on Runpod.

input.name: Max Num Seqs
input.description: Most sequences vLLM schedules at once; Holo4's Mamba cache holds 125 on a 48 GB GPU
